subject: Edge/runtime on-call HC proposal and comp bands
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Edge/runtime on-call HC proposal and comp bands

Hi team,

I've attached a short proposal (edge-oncall-hc-proposal.pdf) asking for approval to add two dedicated on-call engineers to the Edge/Runtime squad (Platform infra). Summary: +2 FTEs (L3/L4 mix) to cover 24x7 on-call rotation for the next 12 months. Rationale: recent production incidents increased after-hours load; we need dedicated pager coverage to meet our SLOs and reduce toil for the core infra team.

Key asks:
- Approval to create 2 headcount slots (one L3, one L4) under Platform/Runtime (Q1 start).
- Permission to recruit via external partner (cc'ing Sara at TalentEdge) and internal ladder for the L3.
- Budget allocation of ~$340k-380k total fully loaded (salary + benefits) — detailed in the attached comp-band spreadsheet.

Notes:
- Suggested hiring plan: offer L4 first (benchmarked to market) and L3 concurrently with recruiter pipeline.
- Can do canary hiring (1st role immediate, 2nd on 90-day review).

I recommend we treat these as operational hires tied to incident reduction KPIs (MTTA/MTTR improvement target). If you want, I can prepare a 5‑minute slide for next week's exec sync.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sr. Engineering Manager, Platform Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: edge-oncall-hc-proposal.pdf, comp-band-table-q1-2027.xlsx
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Edge/runtime on-call HC proposal and comp bands

Thanks Marcus — clear ask and good context. A couple quick clarifying questions before I greenlight:

1) Is the ~$340k-380k fully loaded per headcount or total for both? I couldn't tell from the one-pager.
2) Who is the escalation owner for the 90-day canary review? I want the owner and the KPI targets spelled out.
3) Can Finance confirm the budget is available in the Platform Q1 capex/opex forecast? I'll need a short note from Finance to finalize approval.

If you can reply with those details today, I can move this to approved or request a short exec review.

- Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 13:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Edge/runtime on-call HC proposal and comp bands

Lauren / Marcus — attaching the comp-band table (comp-band-table-q1-2027.xlsx) as requested and summarizing here:

- The $340k-380k figure is the TOTAL for both hires (fully loaded), assuming midpoint salary for the L4 at $185k + benefits and L3 at $110k + benefits, plus recruiting fees.
- If we decide to make the L4 a higher seniority (senior L4), budget delta is +$30k.

Recommended offer bands for immediate use:
- L3 (IC3): base $95k-$120k, target offer midpoint $105k.
- L4 (IC4): base $150k-$200k, target offer midpoint $175k.

Recruiting plan notes: TalentEdge fee model is 20% on first-year base for external hire; internal lift for L3 expected to be lower (internal referral). I can draft formal bands into Workday once we approve headcount.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Total Rewards
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jan 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Edge/runtime on-call HC proposal and comp bands

Thanks — I support adding the two slots with the following caveats:

- Approve 1 immediate hire (L4) and 1 conditional slot (L3) to be released after 90 days pending MTTR reduction and incident frequency metrics.
- Require Marcus to provide a 90-day measurement plan and the person who will own the metric (nominated: Laura Bennett).
- Cap external recruiting spend for the role at 20% fee; if we exceed the band midpoint by more than 10% for the L4, escalate to me for approval.

If those are acceptable, consider this an approval in principle and route to Finance for budget sign‑off.

Jonas Weber
Head of Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sara Malik <sara@talentedge.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jan 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Edge/runtime on-call HC proposal and comp bands

Got it — thanks Jonas. Laura will own the 90-day metric (MTTR target: 30% reduction vs. baseline; incident frequency down 25%). I'll prepare a short measurement plan and the runbook for the on-call responsibilities by EOD Wednesday (see draft link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EdgeOncallStaffingProposal).

Sara (TalentEdge) — can you start candidate outreach for the L4 role using the attached JD draft? We prefer external for the L4; internal referral pipeline for L3. Please confirm timeline and initial candidate list next week.

Marcus

Thanks — TalentEdge will open the role immediately and send an initial shortlist of 6 candidates for the L4 by next Thursday. Typical timeline: 2–3 weeks to shortlist, 1–2 weeks for interviews and offer. We acknowledge the 20% fee cap; we will flag any candidate above the midpoint too.

I'll also reach out to Alex Doe (already in our network) who matches the IC4 profile; Alex is open to conversations — copying his contact above.
